---
title: "HPV community follow-up trial: pre-specified analysis"
subtitle: "Registered Statistical Analysis Plan v2.1 (7 October 2026)"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    number_sections: true
params:
  data: "../outputs/analysis_dataset.rds"
  out_dir: "../outputs"
  functions: "../R/hpv_functions.R"
  analysis_functions: "../R/hpv_analysis_functions.R"
  run_mi: true          # multiple imputation (SAP: required if unknown status >10% in either arm)
  mi_m: 50              # number of imputations (SAP: 50)
  delta_grid: "0,-0.5,-1,-1.5,-2,-3"   # tipping-point offsets on the log-odds scale (cause 2)
  boot_B: 500           # bootstrap replicates for the KM coverage difference (0 = skip)
  seed: 20261001
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = "",
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5.5, dpi = 120)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(purrr); library(readr); library(knitr)
  library(ggplot2); library(lme4); library(survival); library(geepack); library(mice)
})
source(params$functions); source(params$analysis_functions)
set.seed(params$seed)
dir.create(params$out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
kbl <- function(x, digits = 3, ...) knitr::kable(x, digits = digits, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), ...)
save_tbl <- function(x, name) { write_csv(x, file.path(params$out_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")), na = ""); invisible(x) }
pal <- c(Control = "#6b6a66", Intervention = "#2a78d6")
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top"))
```

# Data, populations and model covariates

```{r data}
an <- readRDS(params$data) %>%
  mutate(country = factor(country, levels = c("Mali", "CIV")),
         arm = factor(arm, levels = c("Control", "Intervention")),
         chw_zone = factor(chw_zone), site = factor(site))

# Age: months remaining in the national eligibility window at launch, restricted
# cubic spline with 3 knots (10th, 50th, 90th percentiles of the ITT population).
knots <- rcs_knots(an$months_remaining[an$pop_itt])
an <- add_age_spline(an, knots)
cat("Spline knots (months remaining):", round(knots, 2), "\n")

pops <- list(`All girls (ITT)` = an %>% filter(pop_itt),
             `Randomized girls` = an %>% filter(pop_randomized))
strata <- c("Overall", "Mali", "CIV")
sub_country <- function(d, s) if (s == "Overall") d else d %>% filter(country == s) %>% droplevels()
grid <- expand_grid(population = names(pops), stratum = strata)
unknown_pct <- an %>% filter(pop_itt) %>% group_by(arm) %>%
  summarise(pct_unknown = 100 * mean(is.na(HPV_vaccinated)))
mi_required <- any(unknown_pct$pct_unknown > 10)
kbl(unknown_pct, 1, caption = "Unknown phase 1 status by arm (ITT); MI is required if >10% in either arm")
```

# Participant flow (Figure 3 data)

```{r consort}
flow <- an %>% group_by(country, arm) %>%
  summarise(allocated = n(),
            `by age-out rule` = sum(ageout),
            `excluded at eligibility review` = sum(eligible_final == 0),
            `analysed population (mITT)` = sum(pop_itt),
            `phase 1 status known` = sum(pop_itt & status_known_phase1 == 1),
            `unknown: 1 deactivated/deceased/moved` = sum(pop_itt & unknown_reason %in% "1"),
            `unknown: 2 no information source` = sum(pop_itt & unknown_reason %in% "2"),
            `unknown: 3a aged out` = sum(pop_itt & unknown_reason %in% "3a"),
            `unknown: 3c not reached in time` = sum(pop_itt & unknown_reason %in% "3c"),
            `unknown: 4 parents refused (v2.5 scheme only)` = sum(pop_itt & unknown_reason %in% "4"),
            `phase 2 status known` = sum(pop_itt & status_known_phase2 == 1), .groups = "drop")
flow %>% pivot_longer(-c(country, arm)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = c(country, arm), values_from = value) %>%
  save_tbl("fig3_consort_counts") %>% kbl(caption = "CONSORT flow counts")
```

# Baseline characteristics (Table 1)

```{r table1}
t1_one <- function(d) {
  g <- d$arm01
  bin <- function(x, lab) tibble(variable = lab,
    Intervention = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(x[g == 1], na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(x[g == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),
    Control = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(x[g == 0], na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(x[g == 0], na.rm = TRUE)),
    SMD = smd(as.numeric(x), g))
  cont <- function(x, lab) tibble(variable = lab,
    Intervention = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f); %.1f [%.1f-%.1f]", mean(x[g == 1], na.rm = TRUE), sd(x[g == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
                           median(x[g == 1], na.rm = TRUE), quantile(x[g == 1], .25, na.rm = TRUE), quantile(x[g == 1], .75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Control = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f); %.1f [%.1f-%.1f]", mean(x[g == 0], na.rm = TRUE), sd(x[g == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
                      median(x[g == 0], na.rm = TRUE), quantile(x[g == 0], .25, na.rm = TRUE), quantile(x[g == 0], .75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    SMD = smd(x, g))
  bind_rows(
    tibble(variable = "N", Intervention = as.character(sum(g == 1)), Control = as.character(sum(g == 0)), SMD = NA),
    cont(d$age_years, "Age at launch, years: mean (SD); median [IQR]"),
    cont(d$months_remaining, "Months remaining in eligibility window: mean (SD); median [IQR]"),
    bin(d$ageout, "Allocated by the age-out rule"),
    bin(d$prior_vacc == 1, "HPV-vaccinated before launch (prior_vacc = 1)"),
    bin(is.na(d$prior_vacc), "Vaccination status at launch unknown"),
    bin(d$dob_approx, "Date of birth approximated"),
    map_dfr(levels(droplevels(d$site)), ~ bin(d$site == .x, paste("Site:", .x))))
}
t1 <- map_dfr(c("Overall", "Mali", "CIV"), ~ t1_one(sub_country(pops[[1]], .x)) %>% mutate(stratum = .x, .before = 1))
save_tbl(t1, "table1_baseline") %>% kbl(2, caption = "Table 1. Baseline characteristics by arm (ITT). SMD = standardized mean difference.")
```

# Coverage at baseline and at 12 weeks (Table 2)

Coverage among girls with known status, Wilson 95% CI; difference with the
Newcombe hybrid score CI; relative difference as a risk ratio. The "Overall"
rows pool both countries crudely: because the age-out allocation adds Mali girls
to the intervention arm only, the country mix differs between arms and the
crude overall difference is confounded by country. Interpret the country rows
and the adjusted estimates in Table 3.

```{r table2}
t2 <- pmap_dfr(grid, function(population, stratum) {
  d <- sub_country(pops[[population]], stratum)
  bind_rows(unadjusted(d %>% mutate(base = prior_vacc), "base") %>% mutate(timepoint = "Baseline (before launch)"),
            unadjusted(d, "HPV_vaccinated") %>% mutate(timepoint = "12 weeks (1 July 2026)")) %>%
    mutate(population = population, stratum = stratum, .before = 1)
})
save_tbl(t2, "table2_coverage")
t2 %>% transmute(population, stratum, timepoint,
                 Intervention = sprintf("%d/%d, %s", vacc_int, n_int, fmt_pp(cov_int, cov_int_lo, cov_int_hi)),
                 Control = sprintf("%d/%d, %s", vacc_ctl, n_ctl, fmt_pp(cov_ctl, cov_ctl_lo, cov_ctl_hi)),
                 `Difference, pp (95% CI)` = fmt_pp(diff, diff_lo, diff_hi),
                 `RR (95% CI)` = fmt_ci(RR, RR_lo, RR_hi), `p` = fmt_p(p), test) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Table 2. HPV vaccination coverage by arm (%; 95% CI)")
```

# Primary analysis: coverage at 12 weeks (Table 3)

Mixed-effects logistic regression: `vaccinated ~ arm + country + rcs(months
remaining, 3 knots) + (1 | CHW supervision zone)`. ARD and RR by marginal
standardization (average over the observed covariates, delta-method CI). The
**single confirmatory test** is the ITT overall OR at α = 0.05.

```{r primary}
outcomes_p1 <- list(
  `Coverage at 12 weeks` = list(var = "HPV_vaccinated", filter = function(d) d),
  `Uptake at 12 weeks among girls unvaccinated at launch (supplementary)` =
    list(var = "HPV_vaccinated", filter = function(d) d %>% filter(prior_vacc %in% 0L)))
prim <- list()
t3 <- pmap_dfr(expand_grid(outcome = names(outcomes_p1), grid), function(outcome, population, stratum) {
  d <- outcomes_p1[[outcome]]$filter(sub_country(pops[[population]], stratum))
  r <- fit_glmer(d, outcomes_p1[[outcome]]$var, label = outcome)
  prim[[paste(outcome, population, stratum, sep = " | ")]] <<- r$fit
  u <- unadjusted(d, outcomes_p1[[outcome]]$var)
  r$summary %>% mutate(outcome = outcome, population = population, stratum = stratum,
                       OR_unadj = u$OR %||% NA, OR_unadj_lo = u$OR_lo %||% NA, OR_unadj_hi = u$OR_hi %||% NA,
                       RR_unadj = u$RR %||% NA, RR_unadj_lo = u$RR_lo %||% NA, RR_unadj_hi = u$RR_hi %||% NA,
                       ARD_unadj = u$diff %||% NA, ARD_unadj_lo = u$diff_lo %||% NA, ARD_unadj_hi = u$diff_hi %||% NA,
                       p_unadj = u$p %||% NA, test_unadj = u$test %||% NA, .before = 1)
})
save_tbl(t3, "table3_primary")
show_t3 <- function(t) t %>% transmute(outcome, population, stratum, n,
  `Vaccinated I/C` = sprintf("%d / %d", events_int, events_ctl),
  `Adjusted OR` = fmt_ci(OR, OR_lo, OR_hi), p = fmt_p(p),
  `ARD, pp` = fmt_pp(ARD, ARD_lo, ARD_hi), `RR` = fmt_ci(RR, RR_lo, RR_hi),
  `Unadjusted OR` = fmt_ci(OR_unadj, OR_unadj_lo, OR_unadj_hi),
  `Unadj. ARD, pp` = fmt_pp(ARD_unadj, ARD_unadj_lo, ARD_unadj_hi),
  `Unadj. RR` = fmt_ci(RR_unadj, RR_unadj_lo, RR_unadj_hi),
  `p (unadj.)` = fmt_p(p_unadj), ICC = round(ICC, 3), note)
kbl(show_t3(t3), caption = "Table 3. Primary and supplementary analyses (Table 5 = country rows)")
```

```{r confirmatory, results = "asis"}
cf <- t3 %>% filter(outcome == "Coverage at 12 weeks", population == "All girls (ITT)", stratum == "Overall")
cat(sprintf("**Confirmatory result (ITT, both countries):** adjusted OR %s, p = %s; ARD %s percentage points; RR %s. ",
            fmt_ci(cf$OR, cf$OR_lo, cf$OR_hi), fmt_p(cf$p), fmt_pp(cf$ARD, cf$ARD_lo, cf$ARD_hi),
            fmt_ci(cf$RR, cf$RR_lo, cf$RR_hi)))
rd <- t3 %>% filter(outcome == "Coverage at 12 weeks", population == "Randomized girls", stratum == "Overall")
cat(sprintf("Randomized girls only: OR %s (read together with the ITT estimate; it takes precedence for causal interpretation if the two diverge).\n",
            fmt_ci(rd$OR, rd$OR_lo, rd$OR_hi)))
```

## Effect modification by country for uptake (arm × country)

```{r uptake_interaction}
map_dfr(names(pops), function(pp) {
  d <- pops[[pp]] %>% filter(prior_vacc %in% 0L, !is.na(HPV_vaccinated), !is.na(age_s1))
  f0 <- glmer(HPV_vaccinated ~ arm01 + country + age_s1 + age_s2 + (1 | chw_zone), d, binomial, control = ctrl_glmer)
  f1 <- update(f0, . ~ . + arm01:country)
  tibble(population = pp, outcome = "Uptake at 12 weeks", LRT_p_interaction = anova(f0, f1)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])
}) %>% kbl()
```

```{r caterpillar, fig.height = 7}
if (inherits(pf, "merMod")) {
  re <- as.data.frame(ranef(pf, condVar = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(lo = condval - 1.96 * condsd, hi = condval + 1.96 * condsd,
           grp = reorder(grp, condval))
  ggplot(re, aes(condval, grp)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), height = 0, colour = "grey50") + geom_point(colour = pal[2]) +
    labs(x = "CHW-zone random intercept (log-odds) with 95% interval", y = NULL,
         title = "Figure 6. Caterpillar plot of CHW-zone random effects") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
}
```

# Secondary analysis: time to vaccination over 12 weeks (Table 4, Figure 4)

Girls unvaccinated at launch only. Event: documented vaccination by 1 July;
known unvaccinated girls censored at the end of the 12-week time frame; girls
with unknown status censored at `last_status_date`. RMST difference at τ = the
country day count of 1 July (Mali 84 days; CIV 83 days by date difference); the
pooled analysis uses τ = 84.

```{r tte}
tte_res <- list()
t4 <- pmap_dfr(grid, function(population, stratum) {
  d <- sub_country(pops[[population]], stratum) %>% filter(prior_vacc %in% 0L, !is.na(age_s1))
  tau <- if (stratum == "Overall") 84 else unique(d$tau_p1)[1]
  s <- surv_by_arm(d, tau); cx <- fit_cox(d)
  tte_res[[paste(population, stratum)]] <<- list(surv = s, cox = cx, data = d)
  cum <- s$cum %>% mutate(lab = sprintf("%s wk %s", round(day / 7), arm),
                          val = fmt_pp(cum_vacc, lo, hi)) %>% select(lab, val) %>% tibble::deframe()
  tibble(population = population, stratum = stratum, n = nrow(d), events = sum(d$event_p1),
         tau = tau,
         `RMST Intervention` = s$rmst$rmean[s$rmst$arm == "Intervention"],
         `RMST Control` = s$rmst$rmean[s$rmst$arm == "Control"],
         dRMST = s$dRMST$dRMST, dRMST_lo = s$dRMST$lo, dRMST_hi = s$dRMST$hi, dRMST_p = s$dRMST$p,
         logrank_p = s$logrank_p,
         median_I = s$rmst$median[s$rmst$arm == "Intervention"], median_C = s$rmst$median[s$rmst$arm == "Control"]) %>%
    bind_cols(cx$summary %>% rename_with(~ paste0("Cox_", .x)), as_tibble(as.list(cum)))
})
# Country-standardized overall dRMST (weights = country share of the TTE population),
# because the age-out allocation makes the country mix differ between arms
t4 <- t4 %>% group_by(population) %>%
  mutate(w = if_else(stratum == "Overall", NA_real_, n / sum(n[stratum != "Overall"])),
         se_c = (dRMST_hi - dRMST_lo) / (2 * 1.96),
         dRMST_std = if_else(stratum == "Overall", sum((w * dRMST)[stratum != "Overall"]), NA_real_),
         se_std = if_else(stratum == "Overall", sqrt(sum((w^2 * se_c^2)[stratum != "Overall"])), NA_real_),
         dRMST_std_lo = dRMST_std - 1.96 * se_std, dRMST_std_hi = dRMST_std + 1.96 * se_std) %>%
  ungroup() %>% select(-w, -se_c, -se_std)
save_tbl(t4, "table4_secondary_tte")
t4 %>% mutate(`dRMST, days (95% CI)` = fmt_ci(dRMST, dRMST_lo, dRMST_hi),
         `dRMST country-standardized` = ifelse(is.na(dRMST_std), "", fmt_ci(dRMST_std, dRMST_std_lo, dRMST_std_hi)),
              `aHR (95% CI)` = fmt_ci(Cox_HR, Cox_HR_lo, Cox_HR_hi)) %>%
  select(population, stratum, n, events, tau, `RMST Intervention`, `RMST Control`, `dRMST, days (95% CI)`,
         `dRMST country-standardized`, dRMST_p, logrank_p, `aHR (95% CI)`, Cox_p, Cox_PH_p_arm, median_I, median_C,
         starts_with("4 wk"), starts_with("8 wk"), starts_with("12 wk")) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Table 4. Cumulative proportion vaccinated (%), RMST (days unvaccinated out of tau), Cox aHR")
```

ΔRMST < 0 means girls in the intervention arm spent fewer of the first 12 weeks
unvaccinated (earlier vaccination). CIs use the Greenwood-based variance of the
Kaplan-Meier RMST; if the `survRM2` package is installed, the Uno et al. (2014)
estimate is added to `table4_secondary_tte.csv` as a cross-check.

```{r km_plot, fig.height = 5}
km_plot <- function(key_fun, tmax, title, cross = NULL) {
  df <- map_dfr(c("Mali", "CIV"), function(cn) km_df(key_fun(cn)) %>% mutate(country = cn))
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(time, cum, colour = arm, fill = arm)) +
    geom_step(linewidth = .8) + facet_wrap(~ country, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal) + scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, tmax)) +
    labs(x = "Days since launch", y = "Cumulative proportion vaccinated", colour = NULL, fill = NULL, title = title)
  if (!is.null(cross)) p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = cross, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
    annotate("text", x = cross, y = Inf, label = " crossover 2 July", hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 3)
  p
}
km_plot(function(cn) tte_res[[paste("All girls (ITT)", cn)]]$surv$fit, 84,
        "Figure 4a. Time to HPV vaccination, 12-week time frame (girls unvaccinated at launch, ITT)")
```

## Proportional hazards checks

```{r ph, fig.height = 4.5}
zp <- tte_res[["All girls (ITT) Overall"]]$cox$zph
if (!is.null(zp)) print(zp)
d <- tte_res[["All girls (ITT) Overall"]]$data
ll <- km_df(survfit(Surv(time_p1, event_p1) ~ arm, data = d)) %>% filter(time > 0, cum < 1, cum > 0)
ggplot(ll, aes(log(time), log(-log(1 - cum)), colour = arm)) + geom_step() + scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
  labs(title = "Log(-log) survival by arm (parallel curves support proportional hazards)", colour = NULL)
# If PH is violated for arm: piecewise hazard ratios over weeks 0-4, 5-8, 9-12
if (!is.null(zp) && zp$table["arm01", "p"] < 0.05) {
  sp <- split_periods(d, rep(list(c(28, 56)), nrow(d)), "time_p1", "event_p1")
  pw <- fit_cox_period(sp, c("weeks 0-4", "weeks 5-8", "weeks 9-12"))
  kbl(pw$summary, caption = sprintf("Piecewise HR (PH violated); equality p = %s", fmt_p(pw$interaction_p)))
}
```

## Censoring conditioned on cause

Deaths as a competing event (Aalen-Johansen) if not negligible (> 1% of girls in
the time-to-event population), and girls who aged out (cause 3a) bounded.

```{r tte_cause}
d <- tte_res[["All girls (ITT) Overall"]]$data
dd <- d %>% mutate(dtime = as.numeric(death_date - study_dates$launch[as.character(country)]),
                   status = case_when(event_p1 == 1 ~ 1L,
                                      death & !is.na(dtime) & dtime <= tau_p1 ~ 2L, TRUE ~ 0L),
                   ctime = if_else(status == 2L, pmax(dtime, 0.5), time_p1))
cat("Deaths in the time-to-event population:", sum(dd$status == 2), "of", nrow(dd), "\n")
if (mean(dd$status == 2) > 0.01) {
  aj <- survfit(Surv(ctime, factor(status, 0:2, c("censor", "vaccinated", "death"))) ~ arm, data = dd)
  print(summary(aj, times = 84, extend = TRUE))
} else cat("Deaths are negligible: Kaplan-Meier estimates retained.\n")

bound_3a <- function(d, case) {
  w <- is.na(d$HPV_vaccinated) & d$unknown_reason %in% "3a"
  good <- if (case == "best") d$arm01 == 1 else d$arm01 == 0   # arm assumed vaccinated
  d$event_p1[w & good] <- 1L
  d$time_p1[w & good]  <- pmin(d$tau_p1[w & good], pmax(0.5, d$time_p1[w & good] + 1))
  d$event_p1[w & !good] <- 0L; d$time_p1[w & !good] <- d$tau_p1[w & !good]
  d
}
map_dfr(c("worst", "best"), function(cs) {
  b <- bound_3a(d, cs); s <- surv_by_arm(b, 84); cx <- fit_cox(b)
  tibble(scenario = paste(cs, "case for intervention (3a)"), girls_3a = sum(d$unknown_reason %in% "3a"),
         `dRMST (95% CI)` = fmt_ci(s$dRMST$dRMST, s$dRMST$lo, s$dRMST$hi),
         `aHR (95% CI)` = fmt_ci(cx$summary$HR, cx$summary$HR_lo, cx$summary$HR_hi))
}) %>% kbl()
```

# Sensitivity analyses (Table 7)

```{r sens_setup}
itt <- pops[["All girls (ITT)"]]
sens <- list()
add_sens <- function(name, s) sens[[name]] <<- s %>% mutate(scenario = name, .before = 1)
add_sens("Primary (complete case, ITT)", t3 %>% filter(outcome == "Coverage at 12 weeks",
         population == "All girls (ITT)", stratum == "Overall") %>% select(n, OR, OR_lo, OR_hi, p, ARD, ARD_lo, ARD_hi))
add_sens("Randomized girls only", t3 %>% filter(outcome == "Coverage at 12 weeks",
         population == "Randomized girls", stratum == "Overall") %>% select(n, OR, OR_lo, OR_hi, p, ARD, ARD_lo, ARD_hi))
u <- unadjusted(itt, "HPV_vaccinated")
add_sens(paste("Unadjusted", u$test, "test"), tibble(n = u$n_int + u$n_ctl, OR = u$OR, OR_lo = u$OR_lo, OR_hi = u$OR_hi,
         p = u$p, ARD = u$diff, ARD_lo = u$diff_lo, ARD_hi = u$diff_hi))
```

## Site and arm × country

```{r sens_site}
fs <- glmer(HPV_vaccinated ~ arm01 * country + site + age_s1 + age_s2 + (1 | chw_zone),
            data = itt %>% filter(!is.na(HPV_vaccinated), !is.na(age_s1)), family = binomial, control = ctrl_glmer)
f0 <- update(fs, . ~ . - arm01:country)
b <- fixef(fs); V <- vcov(fs)
or_c <- function(L) { e <- sum(L * b[names(L)]); s <- sqrt(drop(t(L) %*% V[names(L), names(L)] %*% L))
  c(OR = exp(e), lo = exp(e - 1.96 * s), hi = exp(e + 1.96 * s), p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(e / s))) }
site_tab <- rbind(Mali = or_c(c(arm01 = 1)), CIV = or_c(c(arm01 = 1, `arm01:countryCIV` = 1)))
kbl(as.data.frame(site_tab), caption = sprintf("OR by country from the model with site and arm x country; interaction LRT p = %s",
                                               fmt_p(anova(f0, fs)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])))
add_sens("Adjusted for site, with arm x country (Mali OR)", tibble(n = nobs(fs), OR = site_tab["Mali", "OR"],
         OR_lo = site_tab["Mali", "lo"], OR_hi = site_tab["Mali", "hi"], p = site_tab["Mali", "p"]))
add_sens("Adjusted for site, with arm x country (CIV OR)", tibble(n = nobs(fs), OR = site_tab["CIV", "OR"],
         OR_lo = site_tab["CIV", "lo"], OR_hi = site_tab["CIV", "hi"], p = site_tab["CIV", "p"]))
```

## Kaplan-Meier coverage at 12 weeks

Coverage = π + (1 − π)[1 − Ŝ(τ)], π = proportion vaccinated before launch in
the arm; Greenwood-based CI, bootstrap percentile CI as a cross-check. Computed
by country (τ = 84 days Mali, 83 days CIV); the overall estimate is
standardized to the country distribution of the population, because the
age-out allocation makes the country mix differ between arms.

```{r sens_km}
kmc <- map_dfr(names(pops), function(pp)
  km_coverage_std(pops[[pp]], "tau_p1", "time_p1", "event_p1", B = params$boot_B) %>%
    mutate(population = pp, .before = 1))
save_tbl(kmc, "sens_km_coverage_12wk") %>% kbl(4)
add_sens("Kaplan-Meier coverage at 12 weeks (difference, country-standardized)", kmc %>% filter(population == "All girls (ITT)", stratum == "Overall (country-standardized)") %>%
           transmute(ARD = diff, ARD_lo = diff_lo, ARD_hi = diff_hi))
```

## Multiple imputation (cause 3c) and delta tipping point (cause 2)

Imputation model: arm, country, age spline, site, CHW-zone mean coverage
(cluster mean of observed outcomes), number of CHW contacts, days from launch
to last documented status. `baseline vaccination status of household
children` is listed in the SAP but is not in the four CHT tables; add it here
if a household-level extract becomes available.

```{r mi}
mi_out <- NULL
if (params$run_mi) {
  if (!mi_required) cat("Unknown status is <=10% in both arms: MI not required by the SAP; run as supportive.\n")
  base_mi <- itt %>% filter(!is.na(age_s1)) %>%
    mutate(days_last = coalesce(as.numeric(last_status_date - study_dates$launch[as.character(country)]), 0)) %>%
    group_by(chw_zone) %>%
    mutate(zone_cov = (sum(HPV_vaccinated, na.rm = TRUE) - coalesce(HPV_vaccinated, 0L)) /
             pmax(1, sum(!is.na(HPV_vaccinated)) - !is.na(HPV_vaccinated))) %>% ungroup()
  rhs_imp <- "arm01 + country + age_s1 + age_s2 + site + zone_cov + n_contacts + days_last"
  if (n_distinct(base_mi$country) < 2) rhs_imp <- sub("country \\+ ", "", rhs_imp)
  fit_pool <- function(dlist) {
    est <- map(dlist, function(d) { r <- fit_glmer(d, "y"); c(r$summary$logOR, r$summary$se_logOR) })
    pool_rubin(map_dbl(est, 1), map_dbl(est, 2))
  }
  # (i) main MI: cause 3c imputed with mice (logistic regression), m imputations
  d3c <- base_mi %>% filter(!is.na(HPV_vaccinated) | unknown_reason %in% "3c") %>%
    mutate(y = factor(HPV_vaccinated))
  vars <- c("y", all.vars(as.formula(paste("~", rhs_imp))))
  ini <- mice(d3c[, vars], maxit = 0)
  meth <- ini$method; meth[] <- ""; meth["y"] <- "logreg"
  pred <- ini$predictorMatrix; pred[,] <- 0; pred["y", setdiff(vars, "y")] <- 1
  imp <- mice(d3c[, vars], m = params$mi_m, method = meth, predictorMatrix = pred, printFlag = FALSE,
              seed = params$seed)
  dl <- map(seq_len(params$mi_m), function(k) {
    x <- d3c; x$y <- as.integer(as.character(complete(imp, k)$y)); x })
  mi_main <- fit_pool(dl) %>% mutate(analysis = "MI: cause 3c imputed (MAR)", n = nrow(d3c),
                                     imputed = sum(is.na(d3c$y)), delta = NA_real_)
  # (ii) delta-adjusted MI: causes 3c (delta = 0) and 2 (delta shift on log-odds)
  d2 <- base_mi %>% filter(!is.na(HPV_vaccinated) | unknown_reason %in% c("2", "3c")) %>%
    mutate(y = HPV_vaccinated)
  deltas <- as.numeric(strsplit(params$delta_grid, ",")[[1]])
  mi_delta <- map_dfr(deltas, function(dl0) {
    lst <- impute_delta(d2, rhs_imp, shift = d2$unknown_reason %in% "2", delta = dl0, m = params$mi_m)
    fit_pool(lst) %>% mutate(analysis = "MI: causes 2 (delta-shifted) and 3c", n = nrow(d2),
                             imputed = sum(is.na(d2$y)), delta = dl0)
  })
  mi_out <- bind_rows(mi_main, mi_delta)
  save_tbl(mi_out, "sens_multiple_imputation") %>% kbl(caption = "Multiple imputation (Rubin's rules)")
  tip <- mi_delta %>% filter(p >= 0.05 | OR_lo <= 1)
  cat("Tipping point (first delta at which the effect is no longer significant):",
      if (nrow(tip)) tip$delta[1] else "not reached in the grid", "\n")
  add_sens("MI, cause 3c (MAR)", mi_main %>% select(n, OR, OR_lo, OR_hi, p))
  walk(seq_len(nrow(mi_delta)), function(i) add_sens(sprintf("MI, causes 2 and 3c, delta = %s", mi_delta$delta[i]),
                                                     mi_delta[i, ] %>% select(n, OR, OR_lo, OR_hi, p)))
}
```

# Subgroups (Figure 5)

Pre-specified country subgroups, plus age group within Côte d'Ivoire and site,
for (a) coverage at 12 weeks and (b) uptake at 12 weeks among girls
unvaccinated at launch (`prior_vacc = 0`). Each subgroup is fitted with the
primary model (country term dropped within a country). Exploratory, 95% CIs
without multiplicity adjustment. Subgroups without a stable estimate are kept in
the CSV, with the reason in `why_not`, and left out of the plot: not estimable, fewer than 5
vaccinated girls in either arm, or an unstable fit (standard error of the log-OR
outside 0.01–3). The threshold is set by `min_events` in `flag_subgroups()`.

```{r subgroup_fun}
run_subgroups <- function(dat, outcome = "HPV_vaccinated") {
  bind_rows(
    map_dfr(c("Mali", "CIV"), ~ fit_glmer(sub_country(dat, .x), outcome, label = .x)$summary %>%
              mutate(group = "Country")),
    map_dfr(c("9-11", "12-14"), function(a) {
      rng <- if (a == "9-11") 9:11 else 12:14
      fit_glmer(dat %>% filter(country == "CIV", age_years %in% rng) %>% droplevels(), outcome,
                label = paste0("CIV, age ", a, " years"))$summary %>% mutate(group = "Age (CIV)")
    }),
    map_dfr(levels(droplevels(dat$site)), ~ fit_glmer(dat %>% filter(site == .x) %>% droplevels(), outcome,
                                                      label = paste("Site", .x))$summary %>% mutate(group = "Site"))) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Country", "Age (CIV)", "Site")))
}
# A subgroup estimate is plotted only if it is stable: at least `min_events`
# vaccinated girls in each arm and a well-behaved standard error. Others are
# kept in the CSV and listed under the figure.
flag_subgroups <- function(sg, min_events = 5) {
  sg %>% mutate(plotted = !is.na(OR) & events_int >= min_events & events_ctl >= min_events &
                  !is.na(se_logOR) & se_logOR > 0.01 & se_logOR < 3,
                why_not = case_when(plotted ~ NA_character_,
                                    is.na(OR) ~ "not estimable",
                                    events_int < min_events | events_ctl < min_events ~
                                      sprintf("fewer than %d vaccinated girls in an arm", min_events),
                                    TRUE ~ "unstable model fit"))
}
plot_subgroups <- function(sg, overall, title) {
  d <- sg %>% filter(plotted) %>%
    mutate(lab = sprintf("%s  (n = %s; %d/%d vaccinated)", analysis, format(n, big.mark = ","), events_int, events_ctl),
           ci_txt = fmt_ci(OR, OR_lo, OR_hi))
  lim <- c(min(d$OR_lo, overall$OR_lo, 1), max(d$OR_hi, overall$OR_hi, 1)) * c(0.8, 1.25)
  brks <- c(0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64)
  ggplot(d, aes(OR, reorder(lab, OR))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = overall$OR, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = OR_lo, xmax = OR_hi), height = 0, colour = pal[2], linewidth = .7) +
    geom_point(aes(size = n), colour = pal[2], show.legend = FALSE) + scale_size_area(max_size = 3.5) +
    geom_text(aes(x = lim[2], label = ci_txt), hjust = -0.15, size = 3, colour = "grey25") +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = brks, labels = format(brks, drop0trailing = TRUE)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = lim, clip = "off") +
    facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    labs(x = sprintf("Adjusted OR (log scale) with 95%% CI; dashed line = overall estimate, OR %s",
                     fmt_ci(overall$OR, overall$OR_lo, overall$OR_hi)),
         y = NULL, title = title,
         subtitle = "Labels: n analysed; vaccinated intervention / control. Point size proportional to n.") +
    theme(strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, face = "bold"), plot.title.position = "plot",
          strip.placement = "outside", panel.spacing.y = unit(8, "pt"),
          plot.margin = margin(5.5, 120, 5.5, 5.5))
}
fig_h <- function(sg) 2 + 0.32 * max(1, sum(sg$plotted))
```

# Phase 2: status on 1 October 2026 (Table 8)

Randomized comparison of an early versus a delayed start of the intervention
(the control arm crossed over on 2 July 2026). Exploratory.

```{r phase2_cov}
outcomes_p2 <- list(
  `Coverage at 1 October` = function(d) d,
  `Uptake by 1 October among girls unvaccinated at launch` = function(d) d %>% filter(prior_vacc %in% 0L),
  `Coverage at 1 October, status from a visit on/after 2 July (sensitivity)` =
    function(d) d %>% mutate(HPV_vaccinated_phase2 = HPV_vaccinated_phase2_recent))
t8a <- pmap_dfr(expand_grid(outcome = names(outcomes_p2), grid), function(outcome, population, stratum) {
  d <- outcomes_p2[[outcome]](sub_country(pops[[population]], stratum))
  u <- unadjusted(d, "HPV_vaccinated_phase2")
  fit_glmer(d, "HPV_vaccinated_phase2", label = outcome)$summary %>%
    mutate(outcome = outcome, population = population, stratum = stratum,
           cov_int = u$cov_int, cov_ctl = u$cov_ctl, .before = 1)
})
save_tbl(t8a, "table8a_phase2_coverage")
t8a %>% transmute(outcome, population, stratum, n, `Coverage I` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * cov_int),
                  `Coverage C` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * cov_ctl), `Adjusted OR` = fmt_ci(OR, OR_lo, OR_hi),
                  p = fmt_p(p), `ARD, pp` = fmt_pp(ARD, ARD_lo, ARD_hi), RR = fmt_ci(RR, RR_lo, RR_hi), note) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Table 8a. Coverage and uptake on 1 October 2026 by original arm")
map_dfr(names(pops), function(pp) {
  d <- pops[[pp]] %>% filter(prior_vacc %in% 0L, !is.na(HPV_vaccinated_phase2), !is.na(age_s1))
  f0 <- glmer(HPV_vaccinated_phase2 ~ arm01 + country + age_s1 + age_s2 + (1 | chw_zone), d, binomial, control = ctrl_glmer)
  tibble(population = pp, outcome = "Uptake by 1 October",
         LRT_p_arm_x_country = anova(f0, update(f0, . ~ . + arm01:country))$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])
}) %>% kbl()

kmc2 <- map_dfr(names(pops), function(pp)
  km_coverage_std(pops[[pp]], "tau_p2", "time_p2", "event_p2") %>% mutate(population = pp, .before = 1))
save_tbl(kmc2, "table8b_phase2_km_coverage") %>% kbl(4, caption = "Table 8b. Kaplan-Meier coverage on 1 October 2026")
```

## Change between 1 July and 1 October (GEE, arm × time)

```{r gee}
gee_one <- function(d, oct_var = "HPV_vaccinated_phase2") {
  d$oct_status <- d[[oct_var]]
  long <- d %>% filter(!is.na(age_s1)) %>%
    select(girl_id, chw_zone, arm01, country, age_s1, age_s2, `0` = HPV_vaccinated, `1` = oct_status) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(`0`, `1`), names_to = "oct", values_to = "y") %>%
    filter(!is.na(y)) %>% mutate(oct = as.integer(oct), zid = as.integer(factor(chw_zone))) %>% arrange(zid, girl_id, oct)
  f <- as.formula(paste("y ~ arm01 * oct", if (n_distinct(long$country) > 1) "+ country", "+ age_s1 + age_s2"))
  g <- geeglm(f, id = zid, data = long, family = binomial, corstr = "exchangeable")
  b <- coef(g); V <- vcov(g)
  ctr <- function(L) { e <- sum(L * b[names(L)]); s <- sqrt(drop(t(L) %*% V[names(L), names(L)] %*% L))
    sprintf("%s (p %s)", fmt_ci(exp(e), exp(e - 1.96 * s), exp(e + 1.96 * s)), fmt_p(2 * pnorm(-abs(e / s)))) }
  tibble(`OR arm, 1 July` = ctr(c(arm01 = 1)), `OR arm, 1 October` = ctr(c(arm01 = 1, `arm01:oct` = 1)),
         `OR Oct vs Jul, control` = ctr(c(oct = 1)), `OR Oct vs Jul, intervention` = ctr(c(oct = 1, `arm01:oct` = 1)),
         `arm x time p` = fmt_p(2 * pnorm(-abs(b["arm01:oct"] / sqrt(V["arm01:oct", "arm01:oct"])))))
}
t8c <- pmap_dfr(expand_grid(definition = c("HPV_vaccinated_phase2", "HPV_vaccinated_phase2_recent"), grid),
  function(definition, population, stratum)
    gee_one(sub_country(pops[[population]], stratum), definition) %>%
      mutate(`1 October status` = if_else(definition == "HPV_vaccinated_phase2", "last visit on/before 1 Oct (SAP)",
                                          "visit on/after 2 July (sensitivity)"),
             population = population, stratum = stratum, .before = 1))
save_tbl(t8c, "table8c_phase2_gee") %>% kbl(caption = "Table 8c. GEE (exchangeable, robust SE clustered by CHW zone)")
```

## Time to vaccination over the full follow-up, arm × period

```{r phase2_tte}
t8d <- pmap_dfr(grid, function(population, stratum) {
  d <- sub_country(pops[[population]], stratum) %>% filter(prior_vacc %in% 0L, !is.na(age_s1))
  tau <- if (stratum == "Overall") 176 else unique(d$tau_p2)[1]
  s <- surv_by_arm(d, tau, "time_p2", "event_p2", weeks = c(12, 18, 25))
  sp <- split_periods(d, as.list(d$tau_p1), "time_p2", "event_p2")
  cp <- fit_cox_period(sp, c("Before 2 July", "After 2 July"))
  tibble(population = population, stratum = stratum, n = nrow(d), tau = tau,
         `dRMST, days` = fmt_ci(s$dRMST$dRMST, s$dRMST$lo, s$dRMST$hi),
         `HR before 2 July` = with(cp$summary[1, ], fmt_ci(HR, HR_lo, HR_hi)),
         `HR after 2 July` = with(cp$summary[2, ], fmt_ci(HR, HR_lo, HR_hi)),
         `arm x period p` = fmt_p(cp$interaction_p))
})
save_tbl(t8d, "table8d_phase2_tte") %>% kbl(caption = "Table 8d. Full follow-up to 1 October: RMST and HR by period")

        cross = 84.5)
```

## Historical comparison (descriptive)

Coverage gained by the former control arm during phase 2 (2 July – 1 October)
versus coverage gained by the intervention arm during phase 1 (launch – 1 July).

```{r historical}
hist_one <- function(d) {
  c2 <- d %>% filter(arm01 == 0, HPV_vaccinated %in% 0L, !is.na(HPV_vaccinated_phase2))
  i1 <- d %>% filter(arm01 == 1, prior_vacc %in% 0L, !is.na(HPV_vaccinated))
  w_c <- wilson_ci(sum(c2$HPV_vaccinated_phase2), nrow(c2)); w_i <- wilson_ci(sum(i1$HPV_vaccinated), nrow(i1))
  # KM conditional uptake: control S(tau2)/S(tau1); intervention 1 - S(tau1)
  cs <- d %>% filter(arm01 == 0, prior_vacc %in% 0L); is <- d %>% filter(arm01 == 1, prior_vacc %in% 0L)
  k_c <- summary(survfit(Surv(time_p2, event_p2) ~ 1, cs), times = c(84, 176), extend = TRUE)$surv
  k_i <- summary(survfit(Surv(time_p1, event_p1) ~ 1, is), times = 84, extend = TRUE)$surv
  tibble(`Control, phase 2 uptake (complete case)` = sprintf("%d/%d, %s", sum(c2$HPV_vaccinated_phase2), nrow(c2), fmt_pp(w_c[1], w_c[2], w_c[3])),
         `Intervention, phase 1 uptake (complete case)` = sprintf("%d/%d, %s", sum(i1$HPV_vaccinated), nrow(i1), fmt_pp(w_i[1], w_i[2], w_i[3])),
         `Control, phase 2 uptake (KM)` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * (1 - k_c[2] / k_c[1])),
         `Intervention, phase 1 uptake (KM)` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * (1 - k_i)))
}
pmap_dfr(grid, function(population, stratum)
  hist_one(sub_country(pops[[population]], stratum)) %>% mutate(population = population, stratum = stratum, .before = 1)) %>%
  save_tbl("table8e_historical") %>% kbl(caption = "Table 8e. Historical comparison (cannot separate the intervention from time trends)")
```
